title: Length ratio calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct ratio l1:l2 = 100:81, derived from the period ratio.

title: Period identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies the periods T1=1 s and T2=0.9 s from the provided vibration pattern graph (Figure A).

title: Time for pendulum 1
description: Important: States that pendulum 1, starting left, reaches the far right at odd half-integer multiples of its period: t1 = (m + 1/2)T1.

title: Time for pendulum 2
description: Important: States that pendulum 2, starting right, reaches the far right at integer multiples of its period: t2 = nT2.

title: Simultaneity condition setup
description: Important: Sets up the equation (m + 1/2)T1 = nT2 to find the common time when both are at the far right.

title: General solution expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as a general solution, e.g., t = (4.5 + 9k) s, where k is a non-negative integer.

title: Incorrect initial phase
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes both pendulums start from the same side or misidentifies the initial displacement direction from Figure B.

title: Missing general solution
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer for part (2) is only a single numerical time (e.g., 4.5 s) without indicating the periodic nature of the solution.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (seconds for time, ratio is unitless) in the final answers and intermediate steps.
